credit: noviceborsaeng original period fix; WIZARDspace/finegel prior high-rate finding and integer-floor proposal. Independent native real-clock pacing follow-up, not a new bug discovery.
limitations: Known prior rounding issue; many failing budgets are manifestations of the same two branches, not separate vulnerabilities.
Five exact functions and state assignments selected by AST; full Linux-dependent limit/store/app modules and original tests are not imported or run. No fake store/fcntl module.
Whole config module is loaded, text callback is a fixture PlainTextResponse factory, not the official app adapter.
Real-clock isolated burst1 fixture uses advertised refill cadence, NOT Retry-After. Retry-After rounding and PR887 are separate and not fixed/tested here.
Actual arrival timestamps and1ms margin retained; oversleep can hide early advice, so native observations alone do not prove a universal invariant.
Exact mathematical coverage is limited to integer1..1200/min and independent Fraction parsing; not arbitrary huge/fractional inputs or actual deployed config.
Companion uses WIZARDspace/finegel integer-floor suggestion, not newly invented fix; not applied to original PR.
No production requests, storage/auth/rate-limit bypass, Worker/CDN/proxy/concurrency/fairness/full Linux/upstream CI or official adoption.
No protected key in tests; existing protected DID used separately only for authorized summary. No wallet/settled compute/reward qualification.
